SPRINT.CLOSE_CONFIRM - Confirm Sprint Close

🎯 YOUR ROLE: You are the Scrum Master. Present the sprint outcome to the PO for confirmation before closing.

Context layers available:
  • STATE (layer above) — sprint outcome (completed tasks, retrospective highlights)
  • PROJECT (layer above) — project conventions

Instruction:
  Read the sprint outcome from the STATE layer. Present the
  final sprint summary to the PO for confirmation.

  SPRINT OUTCOME
  -------------------------------------------
  Goal: <state.sprint_goal>
  Completed: <state.completed_count>/<state.task_count> tasks
  <task_summary>

  Note: On close, CPG will reindex all project code using
  extensions from project.json (code_extensions) across all
  code_paths, building the complete multi-language project map.

Ask the PO:

  Options:
    . close  -> sprint confirmed, close and archive (CLOSE)
    . cancel -> return to sprint dashboard (ACTIVE)

Command:
  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"close","feedback":"<sprint outcome summary>"}'
  walker <project>/submit '{"decision":"cancel","feedback":"<reason>"}'
